name: Premature collection
description: Fixed schedules sized on a mis-estimate, closures not cancelled, extra lifts after ad-hoc pickups -> low true fill at pickup.

name: Excessively delayed collection
description: Operator delay episodes (driver shortage) and multi-day delays; container reaches 100 % and side waste accumulates.

name: Low tonnage, expensive transport
description: Fixed lift and km fees spread over little mass -> high EUR/t.

name: Unusually expensive route
description: Remote regions (Lappi, Pohjois-Pohjanmaa) with long billable km and remote surcharges; structural, not an anomaly.

name: Material value collapse
description: Cardboard index -48 % and paper -30 % for three months.

name: Temporary material price spike
description: Plastic film index +55 % for one month, +25 % the next.

name: Contamination reducing recyclable value
description: Site contamination incidents of 2-6 days raise contamination by 8-30 percentage points.

name: Unusually high material generation
description: Campaign/inventory periods multiply generation by 1.6-2.5 for 3-10 days.

name: Seasonal low-volume period
description: Manufacturing July shutdown, office summer lull, retail January trough.

name: Holiday peaks
description: Retail December peak, pre-Christmas and post-Christmas returns surges.

name: Site closure
description: Planned closures of 5-28 days; some customers forget to cancel fixed lifts (empty lifts).

name: Missing weight observation
description: Weight sensor fault periods (mass NULL, status FAULT) and devices with no weight measurement.

name: Sensor drift
description: Gradual gain drift 0.1-0.4 %/day, not reported by the device; fixed only by recalibration/replacement.

name: Sensor replacement
description: New sensor id, new calibration (step change), often preceded by a fault period.

name: Sensor calibration error
description: Offset/gain error introduced at a maintenance visit, persisting until next recalibration.

name: Delayed telemetry
description: Latency bursts (hours) and buffered delivery after connectivity outages.

name: Duplicate sensor events
description: Re-sent messages with identical message_id; bursts in some devices.

name: Out-of-order messages
description: Buffered flushes and latency jitter deliver older measurements after newer ones.

name: Delayed operator weighbridge records
description: Operator-specific sharing lags (0-45 days), extra-late tickets, some still unpublished at extraction.

name: Compactor vs weighbridge discrepancy
description: Causes: sensor drift/calibration, side waste on same truck, combined loads split 50/50, outdated stored tare.

name: Collection cancellation
description: Customer cancellations (fee if <24 h notice), hybrid skips at low fill.

name: Partial collection
description: Container not fully emptied (frozen biowaste in winter, jams); residual mass remains.

name: Contract price changes
description: Annual indexation on 1 January and mid-period amendments (lift fee, fuel, credit share, processing, minimum).

name: Incorrect invoice surcharges
description: Wrong fuel surcharge rate, doubled km, remote surcharge on non-remote site.

name: Duplicate invoicing
description: Lift/transport line billed twice for one job.

name: Unmatched collection and invoice
description: Phantom job lines without a collection, completed collections never invoiced, job refs with typos.

name: Maintenance downtime
description: Breakdowns (4-96 h) and preventive maintenance; material during downtime becomes side waste.

name: Moisture increasing mass
description: Rain on outdoor-staged cardboard/paper adds water mass; heavier, denser loads, possible grade downgrade.

name: Change in material density
description: Material mix change (lower density) or compaction setting change (higher density, logged as CONFIG_CHANGE).

name: Multiple fractions at one site
description: Sites with 2-5 streams; recyclables mis-sorted into mixed waste lower its density and waste credit value.

name: Near-threshold ambiguous decisions
description: Actions whose simulated benefit is within +/- EUR 25 or 3 % of doing nothing.

name: False-positive cost anomalies
description: High EUR/t explained by hygiene max interval, pre-closure requests, decommissioning, partial lifts, minimum charges.

name: Economic opportunities masked by missing data
description: Over-servicing on devices with no weight sensor and an operator that does not share weighbridge data.

name: Competing operational constraints
description: Reducing frequency violates biowaste hygiene limits or causes overflow during peaks.

name: Apparent savings disappear after hidden costs
description: Fewer lifts trigger emergency collections, side-waste fees and minimum charges.

name: No action is correct
description: Well-tuned devices where every alternative is neutral or harmful.

name: Wasted trip
description: Blocked access: operator arrives, cannot lift, charges a wasted-trip fee and returns next day.

name: Rejected load
description: Contamination above grade C threshold: no credit and reprocessing fee at mixed-waste rate.

name: Precautionary on-call order
description: On-call customers order a lift 'to be safe' before a weekend or holiday although the fill trigger has not fired; published as CUSTOMER_REQUEST.

name: Fill sensor reads falsely high
description: Material bridging or an object near the fill sensor makes the fill estimate read 88-97 % for 1-4 days while true fill and mass are low; on-call orders follow. The mass reading reveals it. S40 and its frequency are synthetic assumptions and do not describe the performance of the SMART fill measurement.
